entry.name: jit.chromakey
entry.digest: Key images based on chromatic distance
entry.description: Produces an chromakey effect based on a reference color. Tolerance and fade settings allow for control over the resulting combined image. An alternate mode outputs a matrix with the keying values, which can be used by other Jitter objects.
